data.title: Halobetasol + Salicylic acid
data.summary: IV Topical corticosteroids · Combination: super-potent steroid + keratolytic
data.body:
_Topicals · IV Topical corticosteroids_

**Class:** Combination: super-potent steroid + keratolytic

## Mechanism of action
- Salicylic acid (usually 3%) dissolves the cement between corneocytes (desmolytic) → removes scale
- This increases penetration of the steroid into thick plaques

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Thick, scaly plaque psoriasis, hyperkeratotic eczema, lichen simplex chronicus, palmoplantar psoriasis/eczema

## Dose & formulations
- Once or twice daily for up to 2 weeks (max 50 g/week), then taper

## Adverse effects
- Steroid side effects; irritation and stinging from salicylic acid
- Salicylism if used over large areas (especially with renal impairment, children)

## Contraindications
- Face, flexures, children; large body areas; aspirin allergy (relative); untreated infection

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid large areas.

## Viva points
- Salicylic acid improves steroid penetration in thick plaques
- Salicylate toxicity if large areas are treated

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.45 and ch.55 (Agents for hyperkeratosis); Khopkar ch.22 and ch.27. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
